blurb: Guests can enjoy traditional tastings with 5 or 6 wines presented by knowledgeable staff, or more relaxed flight service with selections from the current list. The winery emphasizes sustainable farming and offers a variety of wines including reds, whites, dessert wines, and limited editions. Food can be pre-ordered or guests may bring their own snacks; the venue is dog and kid friendly.
extraNote: $5 refund per bottle purchased to take home, up to the value of the tasting · Traditional Tasting is by appointment only due to staff considerations · Tasting room and patio at 1960 S Livermore Ave, Livermore, CA
